name: dev.workers.mike-tusa.plaingrade-api/plaingrade-api
title: PlainGrade
description: English readability scores (Flesch, Flesch-Kincaid, Fog, SMOG) and text stats. Text never stored.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. 'Bearer <key>': a free key (POST /v1/keys) or a PlainGrade Pro license key (PGPR-..., $5/mo via Polar) for higher limits. Works without a key.
